12	International ACH and Wire Transactions If your Account receives incoming ACH transactions (either credits or debits) or wire transfers initiated from outside of the United States, both you and we are subject to the Operating Rules and Guidelines of the National Automated Clearing House Association (“NACHA”) or the rules of any wire transfer system involved, and the laws enforced by the Office of Foreign Assets Control (“OFAC”). Under such rules and laws, we may temporarily suspend processing of a transaction for greater scrutiny or verification against the OFAC list of blocked parties, which may result in delayed settlement, posting and/or availability of funds. Agreement, the Yield Maintenance Collateral Account and any Prepayment Charge Waiver
Amounts and, for the avoidance of doubt, the Supplemental Interest Trust, the Swap Agreement,
the Swap Account, the Swap Collateral Account and any rights or obligations in respect of the
Swap Administration Agreement) as a REMIC for federal income tax purposes, and such
segregated pool of assets will be designated as “REMIC I”. The Class R-1 Certificates will
represent the sole class of Residual Interests in REMIC I for purposes of the REMIC Provisions.

the REMIC I Regular Interests. None of the REMIC I Regular Interests will be certificated.

CONVEYANCE OF TRUST FUND
REPRESENTATIONS AND WARRANTIES

Section 2.01 Conveyance of Trust Fund.

Pursuant to the Mortgage Loan Purchase Agreement, the Sellers sold, transferred,
assigned, set over and otherwise conveyed to the Depositor, without recourse, all the right, title
and interest of the Sellers in and to the assets in the Mortgage Loans.

The Depositor, concurrently with the execution and delivery hereof, hereby sells,
transfers, assigns, sets over and otherwise conveys to the Trustee for the use and benefit of the
Certificateholders without recourse, all the right, title and interest of the Depositor in and to the
Trust Fund.

In connection with such sale, the Depositor has delivered to, and deposited with, or
caused to be delivered to and deposited with, the Trustee or the Custodian, as its agent, the
following documents or instruments with respect to each Mortgage Loan so assigned: (1) the
original Mortgage Note, including any riders thereto, endorsed without recourse in blank or to
the order of “Deutsche Bank National Trust Company, as Trustee for Certificateholders of
Morgan Stanley Structured Trust I 2007-1, Asset Backed Certificates, Series 2007-1”, showing
an unbroken chain of endorsements from the original payee thereof to the Person endorsing it to
the Trustee, (ii) the original Mortgage and, if the related Mortgage Loan is a MOM Loan, noting
the presence of the MIN and language indicating that such Mortgage Loan is a MOM Loan,
which shall have been recorded (or, for Mortgage Loans, if the original is not available, a copy),
with evidence of such recording indicated thereon (or if clause (x) in the proviso below applies,
shall be in recordable form), (iii) unless the Mortgage Loan is either a MOM Loan or has been
assigned in the name of MERS®, the original assignment (which may be in the form of a blanket
assignment if permitted in the jurisdiction in which the Mortgaged Property is located) to the
Trustee of the Mortgage with respect to each Mortgage Loan in the name of “Deutsche Bank
National Trust Company, as Trustee for Certificateholders of Morgan Stanley Structured Trust I
2007-1, Asset Backed Certificates, Series 2007-1,” or in blank which shall have been recorded
(or if clause (x) in the proviso below applies, shall be in recordable form) (iv) an original or a
copy of all intervening assignments of the Mortgage, if any, with evidence of recording thereon,
(v) with respect to any Mortgage Loan, the original policy of title insurance or mortgagee’s
certificate of title insurance or commitment or binder for title insurance or, in the event such
original title policy has not been received from the title insurer, such title policy will be delivered
within one year of the Closing Date or, in the event such original title policy is unavailable, a
photocopy of such title policy, or, in lieu thereof, a current lien search on the related Mortgaged
Property; and (vi) originals or copies of all available assumption, modification or substitution
agreements, if any; provided, however, that in lieu of the foregoing, the Seller may deliver the
following documents, under the circumstances set forth below: (x) if any Mortgage, assignment
thereof to or intervening assignments thereof have been delivered or are being delivered to
recording offices for recording and have not been returned in time to permit their delivery as
specified above, the Depositor may deliver, or cause to be delivered, a true copy thereof with a
certification by the Seller or the title Servicer issuing the commitment for title insurance, on the
face of such copy, substantially as follows: “Certified to be a true and correct copy of the

Whenever it is provided for in this Agreement that any document, evidence or
information relating to a Mortgage Loan to be included in a Mortgage File be delivered or

first Distribution Date to Certificateholders in accordance with Section 6.04.

Section 2.02 Acceptance of the Mortgage Loans.

(a) Based on the Initial Certification received by it from each Custodian, the
Trustee acknowledges receipt of, subject to the further review and exceptions reported by the
related Custodian pursuant to the procedures described below, the documents (or certified copies
thereof) delivered to the related Custodian on its behalf pursuant to Section 2.01 and declares
that it holds and will continue to hold directly or through a custodian those documents and any
amendments, replacements or supplements thereto and all other assets of the. Trust Fund
delivered to it in trust for the use and benefit of all present and future Holders of the Certificates.
On the Closing Date, the related Custodian will deliver to the Sponsor, the Sellers, the Trustee an
Initial Certification confirming whether or not it has received the Mortgage File for each
Mortgage Loan, but without review of such Mortgage File, except to the extent necessary to
confirm whether such Mortgage File contains the original Mortgage Note or a lost note affidavit
and indemnity in lieu thereof. No later than 90 days after the Closing Date, the related Custodian
shall, for the benefit of the Certificateholders, review each Mortgage File delivered to it and
execute and deliver to the Sponsor and to the Sellers and the Trustee, an Interim Certification. In
conducting such review, the related Custodian will ascertain whether all required documents
have been executed and received and whether those documents relate, determined on the basis of
the Mortgagor name, original principal balance and loan number, to the Mortgage Loans
identified in Exhibit B to this Agreement, as supplemented (provided, however, that with respect
to those documents described in subclauses (iv) and (vi) of Section 2.01, such obligations shall
extend only to documents actually delivered pursuant to such subclauses). In performing any

such review, the related Custodian may conclusively rely on the purported due execution and
genuineness of any such document and on the purported genuineness of any signature thereon. If
the related Custodian finds any document constituting part of the Mortgage File not to have been
executed or received, or to be unrelated to the Mortgage Loans identified in Exhibit B or to
appear to be defective on its face, the related Custodian shall include such information in the
exception report.

(b) No later than 180 days after the Closing Date, the related Custodian, on
behalf of the Trustee, will review, for the benefit of the Certificateholders, the Mortgage Files
and will execute and deliver or cause to be executed and delivered to the Sellers and to the

whether each document required to be recorded has been returned from the recording office with
evidence of recording thereon and the related Custodian has received either an original or a copy
thereof, as required in Section 2.01 (provided, however, that with respect to those documents
described in subclauses (iv) and (vi) of Section 2.01, such obligations shall extend only to
documents actually delivered pursuant to such subclauses). If the related Custodian, on behalf of
the Trustee, finds any document with respect to a Mortgage Loan has not been received, or to be

number, to the Mortgage Loans identified in Exhibit B or to appear defective on its face, the
related Custodian, on behalf of the Trustee, shall note such defect in the exception report
attached to the Final Certification and shall promptly notify the Sellers.

(c) In the event that a Mortgage Loan is purchased by the Sellers or the
related Originator in connection with the Mortgage Loan Purchase Agreement or the related
Bring Down Agreement, the Securities Administrator shall deposit any amounts received into the
Distribution Account. Upon deposit of the Purchase Price in the Distribution Account and upon
receipt of a Request for Release with respect to such Mortgage Loan, the Trustee or the related
Custodian will release to the related Seller or the related Originator, as applicable, the related
Mortgage File and the Trustee or the applicable Custodian shall execute and deliver all
instruments of transfer or assignment, without recourse, representation or warranty furnished to it
by the related Seller or the related Originator, as applicable, as are necessary to vest in such party
title to and rights under the Mortgage Loan. Such purchase shall be deemed to have occurred on
the date on which the deposit into the Distribution Account was made. The Securities
Administrator shall promptly notify the Rating Agencies of such repurchase. The obligation of
the related Seller or the related Originator, as applicable, to cure, repurchase or substitute for any
Mortgage Loan as to which a defect in a constituent document exists shall be the sole remedies
respecting such defect available to the Certificateholders or to the Securities Administrator on
their behalf.

(d) On behalf of the Trust, the Trustee shall enforce the obligation of the
Sellers under the Mortgage Loan Purchase Agreement or the related Originator under the related
Bring Down Agreement to repurchase, cure or substitute for any Mortgage Loan for which a
breach of a representation or warranty made by such party exists and any other obligations of the
related Seller or the related Originator under such agreements, including, without limitation, the
obligation of the Sponsor to repurchase, cure, or substitute for any Mortgage Loan originated by
Accredited in the event that Accredited fails to repurchase, cure or substitute for such Mortgage
Loan.

The Trustee, or the related Custodian on its behalf, and the related Servicer shall provide
access to the records and documentation in possession of the Trustee, or the related Custodian on
its behalf, and the related Servicer regarding the related Mortgage Loans and REO Property and
the servicing thereof to the Certificateholders, the FDIC, and the supervisory agents and
examiners of the FDIC, such access being afforded only upon reasonable prior written request
and during normal business hours at the office of the Trustee, the related Custodian, or the
related Servicer; provided, however, that, unless otherwise required by law, none of the Trustee,
the related Custodian or the related Servicer shall be required to provide access to such records
and documentation if the provision thereof would violate the legal right to privacy of any
Mortgagor. The Trustee, each Custodian and each Servicer shall allow representatives of the
above entities to photocopy any of the records and documentation and shall provide equipment
for that purpose at a charge that covers the Trustee’s, the related Custodian’s and the related
Servicer’s actual costs.

The Trustee shall execute and deliver to the related Servicer and the Master Servicer,
upon such party’s written instruction (which includes the documents to be signed) any court
pleadings, requests for trustee’s sale or other appropriate documents necessary or desirable to (i)
the foreclosure or trustee’s sale with respect to a Mortgaged Property; (ii) any legal action
brought to obtain judgment against any Mortgagor on the Mortgage Note or Security Instrument;
(iii) obtain a deficiency judgment against the Mortgagor; or (iv) enforce any other rights or
remedies provided by the Mortgage Note or Security Instrument or otherwise available at law or

equity.
Section 4.02 REMIC-Related Covenants.

For as long as each REMIC created hereunder shall exist, the Trustee and the Securities
Administrator shall act in accordance herewith to assure continuing treatment of such REMIC as
a REMIC, and the Trustee and the Securities Administrator shall comply with any directions of
. the Seller, the Servicers or the Master Servicer to assure such continuing treatment. In particular,
the Trustee shall not (except as otherwise expressly permitted by this Agreement) (a) sell or
permit the sale of all or any portion of the Mortgage Loans or of any investment of deposits in an
Account unless such sale is as a result of a repurchase of the Mortgage Loans pursuant to this
Agreement or the Trustee has received a REMIC Opinion addressed to the Trustee prepared at
the expense of the Trust Fund; (b) other than with respect to a substitution pursuant to the
Mortgage Loan Purchase Agreement or Section 2.03 of this Agreement, as applicable, accept any
contribution to any REMIC after the Startup Day without receipt of a REMIC Opinion; or (c)
acquire any assets for any REMIC other than any REO Property after the Startup Day without
receipt of a REMIC Opinion.

Section 4.03 Monitoring of the Servicers.

(a) The Master Servicer shall be responsible for reporting to the Trustee, the
Sponsor and the Seller the non-compliance by the related Servicer with its duties under this
Agreement and the related Servicing Agreement. In the review of the related Servicer’s
activities, the Master Servicer may rely upon an Officer’s Certificate of the related Servicer with
regard to such Person’s compliance with the terms of this Agreement or the related Servicing
Agreement. In the event that the Master Servicer, in its judgment, determines that the related
Servicer (other than Wells Fargo) should be terminated in accordance with this Agreement or the
related Servicing Agreement, or that a notice should be sent pursuant to this Agreement or the
related Servicing Agreement with respect to the occurrence of an event that, unless cured, would
constitute grounds for such termination, the Master Servicer shall notify the Seller and the
Trustee and the Master Servicer shall issue such notice or take such other action as it deems
appropriate.

(b) The Master Servicer, for the benefit of the Trustee and the
Certificateholders, shall enforce the obligations of each Servicer under the related Servicing
Agreement, and shall, in the event that a Servicer, other than Wells Fargo, fails to perform its
obligations in accordance with the related Servicing Agreement, subject to the preceding
paragraph, terminate the rights and obligations of such Servicer thereunder and act as servicer of
the related Mortgage Loans or to cause the Trustee to enter into a new Servicing Agreement with
a successor servicer selected by the Master Servicer; provided, however, it is understood and
acknowledged by the parties hereto that there will be a period of transition (not to exceed 90
days) before the actual servicing functions can be fully transferred to such successor servicer. In
the event that Wells Fargo fails to perform its obligations in accordance with the Wells Fargo
Servicing Agreement, subject to the preceding paragraph, the Master Servicer shall notify the
Trustee in writing of such failure. Pursuant to its receipt of such notification from the Master
Servicer, the Trustee shall terminate the rights and obligations of Wells Fargo under the Wells
Fargo Servicing Agreement and enter in to a new Servicing Agreement with a successor servicer
selected by the Trustee; provided, however, it is understood and acknowledged by the parties
hereto that there will be a period of transition (not to exceed 90 days) before the actual servicing
functions can be fully transferred to such successor servicer. In either event, such enforcement,
including, without limitation, the legal prosecution of claims, termination of the related Servicing
Agreement and the pursuit of other appropriate remedies, shall be in such form and carried out to
such an extent and at such time as the Master Servicer (or in the case Wells Fargo is terminated
as a Servicer, the successor servicer or the Trustee, as applicable) in its good faith business
judgment, would require were it the owner of the related Mortgage Loans. The Master Servicer
shall pay the costs of such enforcement at its own expense, subject to its right of retmbursement
pursuant to the provisions of this Agreement or the related Servicing Agreement, provided that
the Master Servicer shall not be required to prosecute or defend any legal action except to the
extent that the Master Servicer shall have received reasonable indemnity for its costs and
expenses in pursuing such action. In the event that Wells Fargo is terminated as a Servicer, the
Trustee shall pay the costs of such enforcement at its own expense, subject to its right to be
reimbursed for such costs from the Distribution Account pursuant to Section 4.03(c);. provided
that the Trustee shall not be required to prosecute or defend any legal action except to the extent
that the Trustee shall have received reasonable indemnity for its costs and expenses in pursuing
such action. Nothing herein shall impose any obligation on the part of the Trustee to assume or

(c) In the event that Wells Fargo is terminated as a Servicer, to the extent that
the costs and expenses of the Trustee related to any termination of Wells Fargo, or the
enforcement or prosecution of related claims, rights or remedies, or the appointment of a
Successor Servicer (including, without limitation, (i) all legal costs and expenses and all due
diligence costs and expenses associated with an evaluation of the potential termination of the
Wells Fargo as a result of an event of default by Wells Fargo and (ii) all costs and expenses
associated with the complete transfer of servicing, including all servicing files and all servicing
data and the completion, correction or manipulation of such servicing data as may be required by
the successor Servicer to correct any errors or insufficiencies in the servicing data or otherwise to
enable the successor servicer to service the Mortgage Loans in accordance with the related
Servicing Agreement) are not fully and timely reimbursed by Wells Fargo after such termination,
the Trustee shall be entitled to reimbursement of such costs and expenses from the Distribution
Account. In all other cases, to the extent that the costs and expenses of the Master Servicer
related to any termination of a Servicer (other than Wells Fargo), the enforcement or prosecution
of related claims, rights or remedies or appointment of a successor servicer or the transfer and
assumption of servicing by the Master Servicer with respect to any Servicing Agreement
(including, without limitation, (i) all legal costs and expenses and all due diligence costs and
expenses associated with an evaluation of the potential termination of a Servicer as a result of an
event of default by such Servicer and (ii) all costs and expenses associated with the complete
transfer of servicing, including all servicing files and all servicing data and the completion,
correction or manipulation of such servicing data as may be required by the successor servicer to
correct any errors or insufficiencies in the servicing data or otherwise to enable the successor
servicer to service the Mortgage Loans in accordance with the related Servicing Agreement) are
not fully and timely reimbursed by the terminated Servicer, the Master Servicer shall be entitled
to reimbursement of such costs and expenses from the Distribution Account.

(d) | The Master Servicer shall require the related Servicer to comply with the
remittance requirements and other obligations set forth in this Agreement or the related Servicing
Agreement, as applicable.

(e) If the Master Servicer acts as a servicer, it will not assume liability for the
representations and warranties of the related Servicer, if any, that it replaces.

Section 4.04 Fidelity Bond.

The Master Servicer, at its expense, shall maintain in effect a blanket fidelity bond and an
errors and omissions insurance policy, affording coverage with respect to all directors, officers,
employees and other Persons acting on such Master Servicer’s behalf, and covering errors and
omissions in the performance of the Master Servicer’s obligations hereunder. The errors and —
omissions insurance policy and the fidelity bond shall be in such form and amount generally
acceptable for entities serving as master servicers or trustees.

{"judgments": [
{"clause_id":"c001","reasoning_cat1":"A standard preamble identifying the parties and their capacities; no term in it is ambiguous or vague.","reasoning_cat2":"Wells Fargo's dual role as Master Servicer and Securities Administrator is carried consistently through Sections 2.03, 4.01 and 4.03, and the Trustee is Deutsche Bank throughout.","prob_cat1":0.04,"prob_cat2":0.04},
{"clause_id":"c002","reasoning_cat1":"A one-sentence recital of ownership; 'hereby conveyed ... in return for the Certificates' is short but its meaning is plain.","reasoning_cat2":"It is a Preliminary Statement recital sitting against the operative conveyance in Section 2.01 (Sellers to Depositor, Depositor to Trustee) and Section 2.06, so a recital-versus-operative argument is conceivable though the two point the same way.","prob_cat1":0.09,"prob_cat2":0.16},
{"clause_id":"c003","reasoning_cat1":"A tax designation with an exhaustive parenthetical exclusion list; the language is technical but determinate.","reasoning_cat2":"The excluded assets track Section 4.22 (Reserve Fund, Swap Account, Supplemental Interest Trust) and the REMIC covenants in Section 4.02, so the fit is coherent.","prob_cat1":0.07,"prob_cat2":0.07},
{"clause_id":"c004","reasoning_cat1":"A footnote fixing the 'latest possible maturity date'; the OCR garbling of the footnote marker does not change the meaning.","reasoning_cat2":"Consistent with the identical footnotes for REMICs II–VI and with the definition of Uncertificated REMIC I Pass-Through Rate.","prob_cat1":0.05,"prob_cat2":0.04},
{"clause_id":"c005","reasoning_cat1":"Technical REMIC II designation; it miscites Treasury Regulation 1.860G-1(a)(4)(ii) where the parallel provisions cite (a)(4)(iii), a small citation slip.","reasoning_cat2":"The (a)(4)(ii) citation conflicts with the REMIC I, III–VI statements and with its own footnote, which all cite (a)(4)(iii).","prob_cat1":0.16,"prob_cat2":0.16},
{"clause_id":"c006","reasoning_cat1":"Footnotes defining notional amount and maturity date; determinate and cross-referenced to defined terms.","reasoning_cat2":"Consistent with the definition of Uncertificated Notional Amount and with the REMIC II table.","prob_cat1":0.05,"prob_cat2":0.05},
{"clause_id":"c007","reasoning_cat1":"The text repeatedly writes 'REMIC II' where REMIC III is meant ('designated as \"REMIC II\"', 'Residual Interests in REMIC II'), a mechanical error that changes what the sentence says.","reasoning_cat2":"That mislabelling collides with the separate REMIC II statement (c005) and with Section 2.06(c), which conveys the REMIC II Regular Interests into REMIC III.","prob_cat1":0.24,"prob_cat2":0.21},
{"clause_id":"c008","reasoning_cat1":"'Class JO Distribution Amounts' is an OCR slip for Class IO, but the carve-out ('other than the Class P, Class CE and Class R Certificates') is precise.","reasoning_cat2":"It matches the class-by-class definitions (c050–c094) and Section 4.22's treatment of Basis Risk and Class IO amounts.","prob_cat1":0.08,"prob_cat2":0.08},
{"clause_id":"c009","reasoning_cat1":"Dense tax footnotes; each is specific about how excess amounts are deemed paid, with no term left open.","reasoning_cat2":"Expressly harmonised with Section 4.22 and the Net Rate Cap definition, which it cross-references.","prob_cat1":0.07,"prob_cat2":0.08},
{"clause_id":"c010","reasoning_cat1":"A designation sentence for REMIC IV; 'Class R-4 Interest' rather than certificate is used but consistently.","reasoning_cat2":"Section 2.06(d) conveys the Class CE Interest for the benefit of Class CE and Class RX holders in respect of the Class R-4 Interest, which matches this statement.","prob_cat1":0.05,"prob_cat2":0.07},
{"clause_id":"c011","reasoning_cat1":"Two short footnotes; both are definite.","reasoning_cat2":"Consistent with the Class CE Certificate definition and Section 2.06(d).","prob_cat1":0.04,"prob_cat2":0.04},
{"clause_id":"c012","reasoning_cat1":"REMIC V designation; plain and technical.","reasoning_cat2":"Matches Section 2.06(e) conveying the Class P Interest and the Class P Certificate definition.","prob_cat1":0.04,"prob_cat2":0.05},
{"clause_id":"c013","reasoning_cat1":"Short footnotes; determinate.","reasoning_cat2":"Consistent with Section 6.08 (Class P Certificate Account) and Section 2.06(e).","prob_cat1":0.04,"prob_cat2":0.04},
{"clause_id":"c014","reasoning_cat1":"REMIC VI designation; technical but definite.","reasoning_cat2":"Matches Section 2.06(f) and Section 4.22(a), which puts REMIC VI Regular Interest IO in the Supplemental Interest Trust.","prob_cat1":0.05,"prob_cat2":0.06},
{"clause_id":"c015","reasoning_cat1":"Footnotes setting out that the interest has no principal balance or pass-through rate; specific.","reasoning_cat2":"Consistent with Section 4.22(c)'s deemed-payment mechanics for REMIC VI Regular Interest IO.","prob_cat1":0.05,"prob_cat2":0.06},
{"clause_id":"c016","reasoning_cat1":"A naming provision; 'may be referred to as' is permissive but nothing turns on it.","reasoning_cat2":"The trust name differs from the Depositor's (Bear Stearns) name, but Section 2.01's endorsement language uses the same Morgan Stanley trust name, so it is coherent.","prob_cat1":0.06,"prob_cat2":0.09},
{"clause_id":"c017","reasoning_cat1":"A boilerplate consideration clause with nothing to construe.","reasoning_cat2":"It lists the four signatories consistently with the preamble.","prob_cat1":0.03,"prob_cat2":0.03},
{"clause_id":"c018","reasoning_cat1":"'unless the context otherwise requires' is itself an open-textured qualifier that can be used to displace a defined term, though it is universal boilerplate.","reasoning_cat2":"It governs all of Article I and is not contradicted by any interpretation provision elsewhere in the instrument.","prob_cat1":0.13,"prob_cat2":0.06},

{"clause_id":"c224","reasoning_cat1":"A lesser-of formula with an explicit deeming rule; complete.","reasoning_cat2":"Consistent with Excess Cashflow, Principal Funds and Overcollateralization Target Amount.","prob_cat1":0.05,"prob_cat2":0.06},
{"clause_id":"c225","reasoning_cat1":"A three-branch stepdown formula; each branch is spelled out and the floor figure matches the $3,675,502 used in the Principal Distribution Amount definitions.","reasoning_cat2":"Depends on the Stepdown Date and Trigger Event definitions, which supply the branch conditions; no conflict found.","prob_cat1":0.06,"prob_cat2":0.08},
{"clause_id":"c226","reasoning_cat1":"'any ownership interest ... whether direct or indirect, legal or beneficial' is deliberately all-encompassing rather than ambiguous.","reasoning_cat2":"Consistent with the Permitted Transferee definition and the Article VII transfer restrictions.","prob_cat1":0.08,"prob_cat2":0.06},
{"clause_id":"c227","reasoning_cat1":"The opening sentence lists 'the Class CE Pass-Through Rate' as an available Pass-Through Rate while the next sentence says the Class CE Certificate has no Pass-Through Rate; the distinction between the Class CE Interest and Certificate rescues it only on a careful reading.","reasoning_cat2":"It must be squared with the Class CE Pass-Through Rate definition and the Preliminary Statement footnotes, which allocate the rate to the Interest rather than the Certificate.","prob_cat1":0.20,"prob_cat2":0.19},
{"clause_id":"c228","reasoning_cat1":"A one-line capacity definition.","reasoning_cat2":"Consistent with the Securities Administrator's distribution role in Sections 5.02–5.03 and 6.04.","prob_cat1":0.03,"prob_cat2":0.04},
{"clause_id":"c229","reasoning_cat1":"Two alternative methods (face amount or computed fraction) without a rule for which prevails if they diverge; 'the such Class' is a typo.","reasoning_cat2":"Depends on the Denomination definition, whose own quotation is garbled, so the two interlocking definitions are both slightly damaged.","prob_cat1":0.19,"prob_cat2":0.14},
{"clause_id":"c230","reasoning_cat1":"A precise cap definition with an express disregard of the Maximum/Minimum rates.","reasoning_cat2":"Consistent with the Maximum and Minimum Mortgage Rate definitions and the Mortgage Loan Schedule field.","prob_cat1":0.05,"prob_cat2":0.05},
{"clause_id":"c231","reasoning_cat1":"A ten-item list closing with clause (x), 'such other investments ... acceptable to each Rating Agency', a broad catch-all, and the provisos use undefined terms like 'purchased at a deep discount'.","reasoning_cat2":"The proviso exempts 'investments in units of money market funds pursuant to clause (v) above', but money market funds are clause (viii) and clause (v) is guaranteed reinvestment agreements, so the internal cross-reference does not work.","prob_cat1":0.44,"prob_cat2":0.34},
{"clause_id":"c232","reasoning_cat1":"An extremely long tax-driven definition, but each exclusion is tied to a specific Code section; limb (z) turns on an Opinion of Counsel rather than an objective test.","reasoning_cat2":"Interlocks with the Ownership Interest definition and the Residual Certificate transfer restrictions; no conflict identified.","prob_cat1":0.14,"prob_cat2":0.11},
{"clause_id":"c233","reasoning_cat1":"A conventional exhaustive list of entity types.","reasoning_cat2":"No competing definition anywhere.","prob_cat1":0.03,"prob_cat2":0.03},
{"clause_id":"c234","reasoning_cat1":"'The applicable rate of prepayment, as described in the Prospectus Supplement' points wholly outside the instrument and gives no rate on its face.","reasoning_cat2":"The Prospectus Supplement is not an exhibit to or otherwise defined in this Agreement, so the term has no source within the instrument.","prob_cat1":0.32,"prob_cat2":0.28},
{"clause_id":"c235","reasoning_cat1":"Three near-synonyms ('premium, penalty or charge') tied to the Mortgage Note; broad but bounded.","reasoning_cat2":"Consistent with the Prepayment Charge Waiver Amount and Class P Certificate definitions.","prob_cat1":0.08,"prob_cat2":0.07},
{"clause_id":"c236","reasoning_cat1":"Short and specific.","reasoning_cat2":"It cites Section 5.01(a) (Master Servicer Account) as the source of the payment, which is plausible, and the amount is excluded from REMIC I in c003; consistent.","prob_cat1":0.07,"prob_cat2":0.11},
{"clause_id":"c237","reasoning_cat1":"The subtraction is of '(a) the related Servicing Fee, (b) the Master Servicing Fee Rate and (c) the LPMI Fee' — subtracting a rate alongside two fees is a mechanical error that makes the arithmetic incoherent.","reasoning_cat2":"The parallel Net Mortgage Rate definition subtracts three rates and the Interest Funds definition subtracts three fees, so this hybrid fits neither.","prob_cat1":0.30,"prob_cat2":0.25},
{"clause_id":"c238","reasoning_cat1":"A precisely bounded 16th-to-15th window with a first-period carve-out.","reasoning_cat2":"Runs alongside the Due Period definition; the two windows differ deliberately and the distribution formulas use each expressly.","prob_cat1":0.06,"prob_cat2":0.09},
{"clause_id":"c239","reasoning_cat1":"The closing words 'or any replacement policy therefor through the related Interest Accrual Period for such Class relating to a Distribution Date' are unintelligible in a policy definition and appear to be text imported from elsewhere.","reasoning_cat2":"Section 4.11 requires maintenance of the Primary Mortgage Insurance Policies, so the garbled tail affects an operative obligation; it also overlaps with the LPMI Policy definition without a stated relationship.","prob_cat1":0.35,"prob_cat2":0.24}
]}

{"judgments": [
{"clause_id":"c240","reasoning_cat1":"A short three-term formula; every input is defined.","reasoning_cat2":"Consistent with Principal Funds, Extra Principal Distribution Amount and Overcollateralization Release Amount and the Section 6.04 waterfall.","prob_cat1":0.05,"prob_cat2":0.06},
{"clause_id":"c241","reasoning_cat1":"A very long list with damaged numbering and a missing comma before '(e)'; the phrase 'or by another Servicer' is left dangling without a governing section.","reasoning_cat2":"Limb (e) cites 'Section 2.03(d)' for Substitution Adjustment Amounts, but Section 2.03 has only subsections (a) and (b), so the cross-reference has no target.","prob_cat1":0.26,"prob_cat2":0.40},
{"clause_id":"c242","reasoning_cat1":"A definition with an express inclusion of repurchases and a rule for partial prepayments; determinate.","reasoning_cat2":"The cross-references to Sections 2.02, 2.03, 4.21 and 11.01 all correspond to real repurchase provisions.","prob_cat1":0.07,"prob_cat2":0.08},
{"clause_id":"c243","reasoning_cat1":"A closed enumeration.","reasoning_cat2":"Consistent with the Offered Certificates and ERISA Restricted Certificate definitions.","prob_cat1":0.03,"prob_cat2":0.05},
{"clause_id":"c244","reasoning_cat1":"Identifies a specific dated document.","reasoning_cat2":"It supplies the source for the Prepayment Assumption definition, though the Prospectus Supplement is not itself an exhibit to the Agreement.","prob_cat1":0.05,"prob_cat2":0.11},
{"clause_id":"c245","reasoning_cat1":"Defined by reference to the Servicing Agreements; determinate.","reasoning_cat2":"Included within the 'Account' definition and used in Section 2.01's prepaid-loan proviso; consistent.","prob_cat1":0.05,"prob_cat2":0.07},
{"clause_id":"c246","reasoning_cat1":"Contains the mechanical error 'plus and (iii)', and the final limb ('any violation of such Mortgage Loan of any predatory lending laws') is ungrammatical, leaving the scope of recoverable 'costs and damages' open.","reasoning_cat2":"It defines Purchase Price only for repurchases 'pursuant to Section 2.02' and purchases under Section 4.21, yet Sections 2.03 and 2.05 also require deposit of 'the Purchase Price' on a repurchase, so the definition does not reach the sections that use it.","prob_cat1":0.42,"prob_cat2":0.44},
{"clause_id":"c247","reasoning_cat1":"Names two agencies with a successor mechanism and a modifier rule; complete.","reasoning_cat2":"Consistent with the Eligible Account and Permitted Investments rating tests.","prob_cat1":0.05,"prob_cat2":0.06},
{"clause_id":"c248","reasoning_cat1":"Four separate loss computations in one definition, each fully specified; long but not ambiguous.","reasoning_cat2":"Depends on Final Recovery Determination, Deficient Valuation and Debt Service Reduction, all of which are defined consistently; the Subsequent Recoveries offset matches c312.","prob_cat1":0.11,"prob_cat2":0.12},
{"clause_id":"c249","reasoning_cat1":"Two mirror-image rules turning on book-entry status; complete though intricate.","reasoning_cat2":"Consistent with the Book-Entry Certificates and Private Certificates definitions.","prob_cat1":0.08,"prob_cat2":0.07},
{"clause_id":"c250","reasoning_cat1":"'leading banks selected by the Securities Administrator' is a discretionary and unmeasured criterion, though the three enumerated conditions narrow it.","reasoning_cat2":"Feeds the Reference Bank Rate and One-Month LIBOR fallbacks; consistent with them.","prob_cat1":0.18,"prob_cat2":0.08},
{"clause_id":"c251","reasoning_cat1":"A detailed averaging and rounding convention with an express fallback; unusually complete.","reasoning_cat2":"Consistent with the One-Month LIBOR cascade and the Reference Banks definition.","prob_cat1":0.08,"prob_cat2":0.07},
{"clause_id":"c252","reasoning_cat1":"A residual-category definition.","reasoning_cat2":"Consistent with the Residual Certificates definition.","prob_cat1":0.03,"prob_cat2":0.04},
{"clause_id":"c253","reasoning_cat1":"A Code-based definition.","reasoning_cat2":"No competing definition.","prob_cat1":0.02,"prob_cat2":0.03},
{"clause_id":"c254","reasoning_cat1":"'subject to such clarification and interpretation as have been provided by the Commission ... or by the staff ... from time to time' makes the content of the term shift with informal guidance.","reasoning_cat2":"It governs Sections 4.17 and 4.18 obligations and the Servicing Criteria definition; those provisions accept the same moving standard.","prob_cat1":0.20,"prob_cat2":0.11},
{"clause_id":"c255","reasoning_cat1":"'or any similar state or local law' is an open catch-all after a named federal statute.","reasoning_cat2":"Feeds the Relief Act Interest Shortfall definition and Section 1.02's shortfall allocation; consistent.","prob_cat1":0.16,"prob_cat2":0.08},
{"clause_id":"c256","reasoning_cat1":"A short and determinate reduction definition.","reasoning_cat2":"Consistent with the Current Interest definition and Section 1.02.","prob_cat1":0.04,"prob_cat2":0.06},
{"clause_id":"c257","reasoning_cat1":"A two-term subtraction of defined amounts.","reasoning_cat2":"Consistent with Excess Spread, Extra Principal Distribution Amount and Excess Cashflow.","prob_cat1":0.04,"prob_cat2":0.05},
{"clause_id":"c258","reasoning_cat1":"A Code-based definition.","reasoning_cat2":"No competing definition.","prob_cat1":0.02,"prob_cat2":0.03},
{"clause_id":"c259","reasoning_cat1":"A pointer definition; it defines REMIC I only by reference to two other places.","reasoning_cat2":"The Preliminary Statement and Section 6.07(a) both describe REMIC I, but REMIC II is defined by reference to the identical section, so the section alone cannot distinguish them.","prob_cat1":0.09,"prob_cat2":0.16},
{"clause_id":"c260","reasoning_cat1":"Describes the interests, their rate and their principal entitlement by reference to the Preliminary Statement table; determinate.","reasoning_cat2":"Consistent with the REMIC I table and the Uncertificated REMIC I Pass-Through Rate definition.","prob_cat1":0.05,"prob_cat2":0.06},
{"clause_id":"c261","reasoning_cat1":"A pointer definition with no independent content.","reasoning_cat2":"It cites the same 'Section 6.07(a)' as the REMIC I definition, so the two definitions point to one undifferentiated source.","prob_cat1":0.09,"prob_cat2":0.16},
{"clause_id":"c262","reasoning_cat1":"A closed arithmetic formula.","reasoning_cat2":"Depends on the Marker Rate and Uncertificated REMIC II Pass-Through Rate definitions; consistent.","prob_cat1":0.05,"prob_cat2":0.06},
{"clause_id":"c263","reasoning_cat1":"A two-limb subtraction; determinate.","reasoning_cat2":"Consistent with the Corresponding Certificate definition and the REMIC II table.","prob_cat1":0.05,"prob_cat2":0.06},
{"clause_id":"c264","reasoning_cat1":"A single-line percentage of another defined amount.","reasoning_cat2":"Ties directly to the Overcollateralization Target Amount definition; consistent.","prob_cat1":0.04,"prob_cat2":0.05},
{"clause_id":"c265","reasoning_cat1":"A closed formula, though the '1 minus a fraction' construction is dense.","reasoning_cat2":"Consistent with the REMIC II Interest Loss Allocation Amount and Corresponding Certificate definitions.","prob_cat1":0.06,"prob_cat2":0.06},
{"clause_id":"c266","reasoning_cat1":"Uses '(i)' and '(ii)' twice in the same sentence for different lists, which makes the cap construction harder to parse.","reasoning_cat2":"The cap mechanics mirror the Marker Rate definition almost word for word, so the two are consistent.","prob_cat1":0.14,"prob_cat2":0.09},
{"clause_id":"c267","reasoning_cat1":"Determinate description with an express IO carve-out from principal entitlement.","reasoning_cat2":"Consistent with the REMIC II table footnote that Regular Interest IO has no Uncertificated Principal Balance.","prob_cat1":0.05,"prob_cat2":0.06},
{"clause_id":"c268","reasoning_cat1":"An incomplete sentence ending without punctuation, and unlike the REMIC I and II definitions it gives no section cross-reference.","reasoning_cat2":"Its asymmetry with the REMIC I, II, IV, V and VI definitions is a drafting inconsistency but does not change any outcome.","prob_cat1":0.13,"prob_cat2":0.13},
{"clause_id":"c269","reasoning_cat1":"An enumeration plus a residual category defined by certificate ownership; clear enough.","reasoning_cat2":"Consistent with the REMIC III Preliminary Statement and the Net Rate Cap definition.","prob_cat1":0.06,"prob_cat2":0.07},

{"clause_id":"c337","reasoning_cat1":"A one-month interest computation with an express shortfall reduction; determinate.","reasoning_cat2":"Cross-refers to Section 1.02, which does allocate those shortfalls among the REMIC Regular Interests; consistent.","prob_cat1":0.05,"prob_cat2":0.06},
{"clause_id":"c338","reasoning_cat1":"A long table with heavy OCR damage to the interest designations, but the pattern is mechanical and recoverable.","reasoning_cat2":"Consistent with the Uncertificated Principal Balance definition and the REMIC I/II tables in the Preliminary Statement.","prob_cat1":0.11,"prob_cat2":0.09},
{"clause_id":"c339","reasoning_cat1":"A multi-paragraph balance definition with an express floor of zero; complete.","reasoning_cat2":"Cross-refers to Sections 6.05 and 6.07(c)(1)(ii), which are the loss-allocation and REMIC distribution provisions; consistent.","prob_cat1":0.07,"prob_cat2":0.09},
{"clause_id":"c340","reasoning_cat1":"A long series of weighted-average formulas; repetitive but each branch is fully specified.","reasoning_cat2":"Consistent with the REMIC I table and the Uncertificated REMIC II Pass-Through Rate definition that builds on it.","prob_cat1":0.09,"prob_cat2":0.09},
{"clause_id":"c341","reasoning_cat1":"An enormous rate table whose OCR rendering has separated the Distribution Date column from the rate column, making several rows hard to match; some rows ('I-13-A through I-74-A' at Distribution Date 61) appear internally inconsistent.","reasoning_cat2":"The table is meant to mirror the Uncertificated REMIC I Pass-Through Rate definition and the REMIC I table; the apparent row mismatches cannot be squared with that mirroring.","prob_cat1":0.24,"prob_cat2":0.20},
{"clause_id":"c342","reasoning_cat1":"A short excess computation plus an express non-reduction rule; determinate.","reasoning_cat2":"Consistent with the Applied Realized Loss Amount definition and Section 6.05.","prob_cat1":0.05,"prob_cat2":0.06},
{"clause_id":"c343","reasoning_cat1":"The allocations do not add up: 93% plus 3% plus 1% to each of five classes is 101%, an arithmetic error on the face of the provision.","reasoning_cat2":"The over-allocation cannot be reconciled with any voting provision that requires a percentage of Voting Rights, and the Residual Certificates definition lists exactly the five classes given 1% each.","prob_cat1":0.49,"prob_cat2":0.35},
{"clause_id":"c344","reasoning_cat1":"A one-line identification confined to the servicer capacity.","reasoning_cat2":"Wells Fargo is simultaneously Master Servicer, Securities Administrator and a Servicer; Section 4.03 addresses the conflict expressly by routing Wells Fargo's termination through the Trustee, so the structure is coherent.","prob_cat1":0.05,"prob_cat2":0.13},

{"clause_id":"c347","reasoning_cat1":"Identifies a specific dated agreement and its amendment; clear.","reasoning_cat2":"Exhibit Q-3 matches the exhibit list; consistent with the Servicing Agreement definition.","prob_cat1":0.04,"prob_cat2":0.06},
{"clause_id":"c348","reasoning_cat1":"A one-line party identification.","reasoning_cat2":"Consistent with the Bring Down Agreements definition.","prob_cat1":0.03,"prob_cat2":0.04},
{"clause_id":"c349","reasoning_cat1":"The definition is truncated — 'the cap contract, dated Agreement Provider' omits both the date and the counterparties, so the instrument being defined is not actually identified.","reasoning_cat2":"The missing counterparty has to be reconstructed from the Yield Maintenance Credit Support Annex definition (Securities Administrator and Yield Maintenance Agreement Provider) and Section 4.22(b).","prob_cat1":0.36,"prob_cat2":0.24},
{"clause_id":"c350","reasoning_cat1":"Circular in form but cured by naming the initial provider.","reasoning_cat2":"The same entity is also the Swap Provider, which the Agreement nowhere flags; not a conflict but a concentration.","prob_cat1":0.06,"prob_cat2":0.08},
{"clause_id":"c351","reasoning_cat1":"A single fixed date.","reasoning_cat2":"Consistent with the Yield Maintenance Agreement definition and Section 4.22(b).","prob_cat1":0.03,"prob_cat2":0.05},
{"clause_id":"c352","reasoning_cat1":"A one-line account definition.","reasoning_cat2":"It cites Section 5.04, which the table of contents titles 'Yield Maintenance Credit Support Annex' rather than an account-creation provision, so the reference is at least imprecise.","prob_cat1":0.07,"prob_cat2":0.24},
{"clause_id":"c353","reasoning_cat1":"Short and specific.","reasoning_cat2":"Consistent with the Yield Maintenance Agreement definition, which includes any credit support annex.","prob_cat1":0.04,"prob_cat2":0.06},
{"clause_id":"c354","reasoning_cat1":"Three parallel allocation waterfalls, each fully specified with pro rata rules; long but not ambiguous.","reasoning_cat2":"Interlocks with Current Interest, Uncertificated Accrued Interest and Section 6.02; the 98%/2% split matches the REMIC II Interest Loss Allocation Amount construct.","prob_cat1":0.11,"prob_cat2":0.12},
{"clause_id":"c355","reasoning_cat1":"The proviso says 'the Seller may deliver the following documents' but every lettered sub-clause then says 'the Depositor may deliver', and clause (v) allows a lien search 'in lieu' of a title policy without saying who decides; the delivery list is the classic battleground over what a complete Mortgage File requires.","reasoning_cat2":"It conveys 'the assets in the Mortgage Loans' to the Depositor while the Trust Fund definition is much broader, and the certification and repurchase machinery in Sections 2.02 and 2.03 depends on exactly what Section 2.01 required to be delivered.","prob_cat1":0.40,"prob_cat2":0.34},
{"clause_id":"c356","reasoning_cat1":"'to appear to be defective on its face' is an open standard governing what must be excepted, and the sentence 'deliver to the Sponsor, the Sellers, the Trustee an Initial Certification' is missing a conjunction.","reasoning_cat2":"'Initial Certification' and 'Interim Certification' are used as defined terms but neither appears in Article I, and the review is expressly narrowed for subclauses (iv) and (vi) of Section 2.01 in a way that limits the Trustee's acceptance.","prob_cat1":0.32,"prob_cat2":0.30},
{"clause_id":"c357","reasoning_cat1":"Turns on whether a document 'appear[s] defective on its face', an open-textured test, and imposes a duty to 'promptly notify' without a defined period.","reasoning_cat2":"'Final Certification' is likewise undefined in Article I, and the notice goes only to the Sellers even though Section 2.02(d) puts enforcement on the Trustee and Section 2.03 requires notice to all parties.","prob_cat1":0.28,"prob_cat2":0.31}
]}

{"judgments": [
{"clause_id":"c358","reasoning_cat1":"The closing sentence makes cure/repurchase/substitution 'the sole remedies respecting such defect available to the Certificateholders or to the Securities Administrator on their behalf' — the list of who is bound is specific and omits the Trustee, and 'a defect in a constituent document' is undefined.","reasoning_cat2":"Section 2.02(d) obliges the Trustee to enforce the repurchase obligations, so whether the sole-remedy limit binds the Trustee turns on reading the two subsections together; the Purchase Price definition also covers only Section 2.02 repurchases.","prob_cat1":0.44,"prob_cat2":0.42},
{"clause_id":"c359","reasoning_cat1":"'and any other obligations of the related Seller or the related Originator under such agreements, including, without limitation, the obligation of the Sponsor to repurchase ... any Mortgage Loan originated by Accredited' is a general obligation followed by a single named specific, leaving the catch-all's reach contestable.","reasoning_cat2":"The Trust Fund definition assigns the Trust rights under the Mortgage Loan Purchase Agreement but not under the Bring Down Agreements, and Section 2.02(c) declares cure/repurchase to be the 'sole remedies', both of which cut against the breadth of this enforcement duty.","prob_cat1":0.42,"prob_cat2":0.45},
{"clause_id":"c360","reasoning_cat1":"The section is headed as representations of the Master Servicer and Securities Administrator yet contains the loan-level discovery-and-notice paragraph, whose terms 'discovery', 'prompt written notice' and 'materially and adversely affects the interests of the Certificateholders' are the classic points of contest.","reasoning_cat2":"Other provisions cite 'Section 2.03(d)' (Principal Funds, Substitution Adjustment Amount) and 'Section 2.03(b)(v)' (Mortgage Loans) and the Replacement Mortgage Loan definition requires compliance with 'each representation and warranty set forth in Section 2.03', none of which exist here.","prob_cat1":0.47,"prob_cat2":0.48},
{"clause_id":"c361","reasoning_cat1":"It says the Section 2.03 representations survive 'delivery of the respective Mortgage Loans and Mortgage Files', but the Section 2.03 representations are corporate representations of Wells Fargo that have nothing to do with loan delivery.","reasoning_cat2":"The Mortgage Loans definition treats 'Section 2.03(b)(v)' as containing a loan-level representation, and Section 2.04 has its own separate survival clause, so this subsection cannot be squared with the way the rest of the Agreement uses it.","prob_cat1":0.30,"prob_cat2":0.44},
{"clause_id":"c362","reasoning_cat1":"'Upon discovery by the Depositor, the Trustee of a breach' omits the conjunction, and the good-title representation is framed in the past tense as of the Closing Date, which muddles when it speaks.","reasoning_cat2":"The notice duty here runs to 'the other parties to this Agreement and to each Rating Agency', whereas the parallel duty in Section 2.03 omits the Rating Agencies — an unexplained divergence between two adjacent notice provisions.","prob_cat1":0.30,"prob_cat2":0.26},
{"clause_id":"c363","reasoning_cat1":"'not in default or as to which default is not reasonably foreseeable' is an open predictive standard with no measure, and it gates the repurchase obligation entirely.","reasoning_cat2":"It sits as a 'notwithstanding any contrary provision' override on Sections 2.02 and 2.03, which set their own repurchase timing, so the two sets of deadlines have to be reconciled.","prob_cat1":0.27,"prob_cat2":0.26},
{"clause_id":"c364","reasoning_cat1":"Well specified: a 5 Business Day notice period, a three-option election and a 90-day repurchase deadline.","reasoning_cat2":"The 90-day deadline runs from discovery, while Section 2.03 fixes deposit of the Purchase Price by reference to the Determination Date in the month after the obligation arose; the two timing rules do not obviously coincide.","prob_cat1":0.15,"prob_cat2":0.25},
{"clause_id":"c365","reasoning_cat1":"An acknowledgment and undertaking in plain terms.","reasoning_cat2":"Consistent with Section 2.01's conveyance and the Trust Fund definition.","prob_cat1":0.05,"prob_cat2":0.07},
{"clause_id":"c366","reasoning_cat1":"A conveyance and acknowledgment in standard form.","reasoning_cat2":"Matches the REMIC II Preliminary Statement and the Class R-2 Certificate definition.","prob_cat1":0.04,"prob_cat2":0.05},
{"clause_id":"c367","reasoning_cat1":"A conveyance and acknowledgment in standard form.","reasoning_cat2":"Matches the REMIC III Preliminary Statement and the Class CE/P/IO Interest definitions.","prob_cat1":0.04,"prob_cat2":0.05},
{"clause_id":"c368","reasoning_cat1":"A conveyance and acknowledgment in standard form.","reasoning_cat2":"Matches the REMIC IV statement and the Class RX Certificate definition.","prob_cat1":0.04,"prob_cat2":0.05},
{"clause_id":"c369","reasoning_cat1":"A conveyance and acknowledgment in standard form.","reasoning_cat2":"Matches the REMIC V statement and the Class P Certificate definition.","prob_cat1":0.04,"prob_cat2":0.05},
{"clause_id":"c370","reasoning_cat1":"A conveyance and acknowledgment in standard form.","reasoning_cat2":"Matches the REMIC VI statement and Section 4.22(a).","prob_cat1":0.04,"prob_cat2":0.05},
{"clause_id":"c371","reasoning_cat1":"The final sentence trails off — 'other than as required or authorized by the terms of this Agreement while any Certificate is outstanding, and this Section 2.07' — leaving the restriction incomplete, and limb (d) ('necessary, suitable or convenient ... or are incidental thereto or connected therewith') is an open catch-all after four specifics.","reasoning_cat2":"The purpose list must be read against Section 4.22, which has the Trust's swap and supplemental interest arrangements sitting outside the Trust Fund; nothing in the list plainly authorises those.","prob_cat1":0.33,"prob_cat2":0.24},
{"clause_id":"c372","reasoning_cat1":"It gives the Master Servicer power to do 'any and all things which it may deem necessary or desirable' while also requiring it to 'cause the Servicers to perform and observe' their obligations — an absolute duty paired with an open discretion, all measured against the vague Accepted Master Servicing Practices standard.","reasoning_cat2":"The absolute 'shall cause the Servicers to perform' cannot easily be reconciled with Section 4.03(a), which lets the Master Servicer rely on a Servicer's Officer's Certificate and act only 'in its judgment', and with Section 4.03(b)'s good-faith-business-judgment enforcement standard.","prob_cat1":0.38,"prob_cat2":0.38},
{"clause_id":"c373","reasoning_cat1":"The covenant is specific in its three prohibitions, but the opening obligation to 'comply with any directions of the Seller, the Servicers or the Master Servicer' is unbounded.","reasoning_cat2":"A duty to obey the Seller's directions sits uneasily with the Trustee's fiduciary role and with Section 4.05's requirement that the Master Servicer act as an independent contractor.","prob_cat1":0.22,"prob_cat2":0.27},
{"clause_id":"c374","reasoning_cat1":"'in its judgment', 'as it deems appropriate' and the permission to 'rely upon an Officer's Certificate' make the reporting and termination duties largely discretionary despite the mandatory 'shall be responsible'.","reasoning_cat2":"That discretion is hard to square with Section 4.01's flat requirement that the Master Servicer 'cause the Servicers to perform and observe' their obligations.","prob_cat1":0.31,"prob_cat2":0.34},
{"clause_id":"c375","reasoning_cat1":"The closing sentence is a double negative that reverses its apparent sense — 'Nothing herein shall impose any obligation on the part of the Trustee to assume ... the duties of Wells Fargo or the Master Servicer unless the Trustee has not been able to find a successor servicer' — and the enforcement duty is qualified by 'good faith business judgment'.","reasoning_cat2":"The mandatory 'shall enforce the obligations of each Servicer' conflicts with Section 4.03(a)'s discretionary 'in its judgment' gate and with Section 4.01's unqualified causation duty; the reimbursement cross-reference to Section 4.03(c) is correct.","prob_cat1":0.44,"prob_cat2":0.40},
{"clause_id":"c376","reasoning_cat1":"Long but exhaustively itemised, with parenthetical examples introduced by 'including, without limitation'; 'the Wells Fargo' is a typo only.","reasoning_cat2":"It is the reimbursement source cross-referenced by Section 4.03(b) and by the Interest Funds definition's reimbursement deduction; consistent.","prob_cat1":0.17,"prob_cat2":0.19},
{"clause_id":"c377","reasoning_cat1":"A one-sentence obligation with no open terms.","reasoning_cat2":"Consistent with Section 4.03(b) and the Remittance Date definition.","prob_cat1":0.07,"prob_cat2":0.09},
{"clause_id":"c378","reasoning_cat1":"A short disclaimer; 'if any' is a modest hedge.","reasoning_cat2":"It sits against Section 4.03(b), which contemplates the Master Servicer stepping in as servicer, and does not address the successor's forward-looking obligations.","prob_cat1":0.11,"prob_cat2":0.16},
{"clause_id":"c379","reasoning_cat1":"'in such form and amount generally acceptable for entities serving as master servicers or trustees' gives no measurable amount or issuer standard, so compliance cannot be tested from the text.","reasoning_cat2":"No other provision fixes a coverage amount or names a beneficiary of the bond, so the vagueness is not cured elsewhere.","prob_cat1":0.35,"prob_cat2":0.17},
{"clause_id":"c380","reasoning_cat1":"'any and all things that it may deem necessary or desirable', 'knowingly or intentionally', and 'reasonably within its control and the scope of duties more specifically set forth herein' are three separate open-textured qualifiers on the same duty.","reasoning_cat2":"The independent-contractor sentence and the reference to 'the provisions of Article XI' (termination) alongside Section 4.03's enforcement duties leave overlapping and partly inconsistent statements of the Master Servicer's role.","prob_cat1":0.34,"prob_cat2":0.26},
{"clause_id":"c381","reasoning_cat1":"The provision is almost entirely circular — everything happens 'in accordance with this Agreement or the related Servicing Agreement' — and 'the original Mortgagor may be released from liability' states a permission without saying who exercises it.","reasoning_cat2":"The Servicing Agreements are exhibits rather than reproduced here, so the operative content is wholly deferred; nothing in the Agreement contradicts it.","prob_cat1":0.30,"prob_cat2":0.19},
{"clause_id":"c382","reasoning_cat1":"The parenthetical '(or if the related Servicer does not, the Master Servicer may)' makes the trigger permissive, and the release is conditioned on a certification 'substantially in the form of Exhibit G (or as otherwise provided in the related Custodial Agreement)'.","reasoning_cat2":"It refers to Exhibit G, which the Request for Release definition also uses; the discharge of 'further responsibility' for the Mortgage File is in some tension with the Trustee's continuing custody obligations under Section 2.02(a).","prob_cat1":0.22,"prob_cat2":0.22},
{"clause_id":"c383","reasoning_cat1":"'Such trust receipt shall obligate the related Servicer' has no antecedent — no trust receipt is mentioned anywhere in the subsection, only a request for release — so the obligation to return the Mortgage File hangs on a phantom document.","reasoning_cat2":"The Request for Release definition and Exhibit G describe a request, not a trust receipt, so the missing antecedent cannot be supplied from elsewhere in the instrument.","prob_cat1":0.36,"prob_cat2":0.27}
]}

{"judgments": [
{"clause_id":"c384","reasoning_cat1":"The access sentence is broken — 'shall provide access to information and documentation regarding the Mortgage Loans to the Trustee and, regarding the Mortgage Loans and their respective agents and accountants' — so it is impossible to tell who is entitled to access; 'The Master Servicer, the related Servicer' also omits a conjunction.","reasoning_cat2":"Section 4.01 contains a parallel but differently worded access provision covering Certificateholders and the FDIC, and the two do not line up on who may inspect or on what terms.","prob_cat1":0.36,"prob_cat2":0.28},
{"clause_id":"c385","reasoning_cat1":"'the Master Servicer, the related Servicer shall be entitled to setoff' omits a conjunction, and declaring the funds 'the sole and exclusive property of the Trustee' while allowing setoff is internally in tension.","reasoning_cat2":"The setoff right has to be squared with the Distribution Account withdrawal regime in Sections 5.02–5.03 and with Section 4.08(a)'s parallel retention rights.","prob_cat1":0.25,"prob_cat2":0.22},
{"clause_id":"c386","reasoning_cat1":"The obligation is enforcement of another agreement's obligation, and 'insurers meeting the eligibility requirements set forth in this Agreement' points to a standard the provision does not state.","reasoning_cat2":"No eligibility requirements for hazard insurers appear anywhere in this Agreement, so the cross-reference to 'this Agreement' has no content to supply.","prob_cat1":0.24,"prob_cat2":0.31},
{"clause_id":"c387","reasoning_cat1":"The mechanics are stated clearly enough once the section references are set aside.","reasoning_cat2":"It says deposits are made 'Pursuant to Sections 5.01 and 5.04' and are subject to withdrawal 'pursuant to Sections 5.02, 5.03 or 5.04', but Section 5.04 is the Yield Maintenance Credit Support Annex, not a deposit or withdrawal provision.","prob_cat1":0.15,"prob_cat2":0.38},
{"clause_id":"c388","reasoning_cat1":"'take such actions ... as shall be necessary to realize recovery' is an open standard, but the parenthetical enumerates what is meant.","reasoning_cat2":"Consistent with the Insurance Proceeds definition's carve-out for amounts applied to restoration and with Section 4.11(b).","prob_cat1":0.18,"prob_cat2":0.13},
{"clause_id":"c389","reasoning_cat1":"'best reasonable efforts' fuses two different standards of effort into one undefined hybrid, and the duty is layered with three separate 'to the extent required under' qualifiers.","reasoning_cat2":"The Primary Mortgage Insurance Policy definition is itself garbled at the end, so the object of this duty is imprecisely identified.","prob_cat1":0.31,"prob_cat2":0.21},
{"clause_id":"c390","reasoning_cat1":"'such reasonable action as shall be necessary to permit recovery' is a soft standard, but the deposit mechanics are clear.","reasoning_cat2":"It acts 'Pursuant to Sections 5.01 and 5.05', but Article V ends at Section 5.04 per the table of contents, so Section 5.05 does not exist.","prob_cat1":0.17,"prob_cat2":0.42},
{"clause_id":"c391","reasoning_cat1":"'Until all amounts distributable in respect of the Certificates have been distributed in full and the Master Servicer otherwise has fulfilled its obligations' uses 'and' where the two limbs do not naturally conjoin, leaving the custody period uncertain.","reasoning_cat2":"Section 4.07 permits release of the Mortgage File to the Servicer on payment in full and discharges the Custodian's responsibility, which cuts against the retention duty stated here.","prob_cat1":0.20,"prob_cat2":0.25},
{"clause_id":"c392","reasoning_cat1":"'as come into and continue in default and as to which no satisfactory arrangements can be made for collection' is an unmeasured standard governing when foreclosure must be pursued.","reasoning_cat2":"It is subordinated to the Servicing Agreements by the closing words, so its operative content is deferred; nothing in the Agreement contradicts it.","prob_cat1":0.27,"prob_cat2":0.15},
{"clause_id":"c393","reasoning_cat1":"Plainly drafted, with an express reduction for Compensating Interest.","reasoning_cat2":"Entitling the Master Servicer to float income here duplicates the same entitlement already built into both the Master Servicing Fee and Master Servicing Compensation definitions, so the same income is granted three times over.","prob_cat1":0.13,"prob_cat2":0.34},
{"clause_id":"c394","reasoning_cat1":"'as expeditiously as possible' is an open standard, and the tax constraint is expressed by reference to Code concepts rather than a rule of action.","reasoning_cat2":"Consistent with the REO Property definition and Section 4.02's REMIC covenants; the REO Imputed Interest definition assumes REO is held in REMIC I, as this provision does.","prob_cat1":0.24,"prob_cat2":0.15},
{"clause_id":"c395","reasoning_cat1":"A single short obligation with no open terms.","reasoning_cat2":"Consistent with the Protected Account definition and Section 4.15(d).","prob_cat1":0.06,"prob_cat2":0.08},
{"clause_id":"c396","reasoning_cat1":"The proviso refers to 'any such unreimbursed Monthly Advances', but the preceding sentence speaks of 'Advances' and 'other unreimbursed advances' — the term shifts mid-provision.","reasoning_cat2":"'Monthly Advances' is nowhere defined in Article I (only 'Advance' and 'Servicing Advances' are), so the proviso's subject cannot be identified from the rest of the instrument.","prob_cat1":0.28,"prob_cat2":0.30},
{"clause_id":"c397","reasoning_cat1":"'the related Distribution Account' implies more than one such account where the Agreement establishes only one; otherwise the timing is specific.","reasoning_cat2":"The Distribution Account definition describes a single account, and the Determination Date and Remittance Date definitions supply the timing; a minor mismatch only.","prob_cat1":0.15,"prob_cat2":0.16},
{"clause_id":"c398","reasoning_cat1":"'in all material respects', 'to the best of such officer's knowledge' and 'the nature and status of the cure provisions thereof' are soft, and the Master Servicer and Securities Administrator are required to deliver the certificate to the Securities Administrator, i.e. in part to itself.","reasoning_cat2":"It deems a Section 4.16 failure 'an Event of Default' although Event of Default is defined as 'As defined in Section 9.01', and it declares that 'This paragraph shall supersede any other provision in this Agreement or any other agreement to the contrary', setting up a direct override of Article IX.","prob_cat1":0.31,"prob_cat2":0.44},
{"clause_id":"c399","reasoning_cat1":"Long but highly specified; the soft points are 'material instance of noncompliance' and the 'taken as a whole' basis for assessment.","reasoning_cat2":"Like Section 4.16 it makes non-compliance 'an Event of Default' and says the paragraph 'shall supersede any other provision in this Agreement', which conflicts with the Event of Default definition keyed to Section 9.01 and with the master-servicer termination machinery in Article IX.","prob_cat1":0.28,"prob_cat2":0.41},
{"clause_id":"c400","reasoning_cat1":"Exhaustively detailed deadlines and allocations of responsibility; the only softness is 'in accordance with industry standards' and the negligence/bad faith carve-out at the end.","reasoning_cat2":"Its deadlines interlock (5 days, 10th day, 12th day, 13th day) and the reliance on 'the representations in Section 2.04(vi)' matches the Depositor's Exchange Act representation; consistent.","prob_cat1":0.19,"prob_cat2":0.17},
{"clause_id":"c401","reasoning_cat1":"The signing and approval deadlines collide — the Master Servicer must sign by close of business on the 3rd Business Day after the Reportable Event, yet the Depositor's approval of changes is due at the same moment.","reasoning_cat2":"That timing is harder to reconcile with the four-Business-Day filing deadline in the opening sentence and with the amendment fallback in Section 4.18(a)(vi)(B).","prob_cat1":0.28,"prob_cat2":0.22},
{"clause_id":"c402","reasoning_cat1":"Extremely detailed; the softness lies in the Securities Administrator's discretion to 'omit from the Form 10-K any annual compliance statement, assessment of compliance or attestation report that is not required to be filed'.","reasoning_cat2":"It requires 'a Sarbanes-Oxley Certification as described in Section 4.18(a)(ii)(D) below', but the certification is in fact described in subsection (a)(iii)(D) of this very provision, so the internal cross-reference is wrong.","prob_cat1":0.21,"prob_cat2":0.35},
{"clause_id":"c403","reasoning_cat1":"The text is broken at the point where the collective term is coined — 'Additional Form 10- Disclosure or any Form _8- K_ Disclosure Information (collectively, the obligation to include such Additional Information ... is subject to' — so the defined term 'Additional Disclosure' is never actually defined, and the notify-and-provide sentence names the same four parties as both givers and recipients.","reasoning_cat2":"'Additional Disclosure' is defined in Article I as 'As defined in Section 4.18', so the broken definition here leaves that Article I term without content, and Section 4.18(a)(v) and 4.18(b) both operate on it.","prob_cat1":0.46,"prob_cat2":0.40},
{"clause_id":"c404","reasoning_cat1":"Detailed procedures with clear fallbacks; the closing 'as the Securities Administrator reasonably deems appropriate' is a modest discretion.","reasoning_cat2":"The final sentence bars reimbursement of Section 4.18 fees from the Trust Fund, while subsections (a)(i)–(iii) make the Depositor responsible for those fees; the two can be read together but sit awkwardly.","prob_cat1":0.17,"prob_cat2":0.22},
{"clause_id":"c405","reasoning_cat1":"The first sentence indemnifies 'the Depositor and the Master Servicer and each of its officers' — the singular 'its' has two possible antecedents, which the second sentence corrects to 'their respective officers'.","reasoning_cat2":"It cross-refers to Sections 4.16, 4.17 and 4.18 consistently, and the 'Securities Administrator Information' construct matches the Article I definition; the parallel indemnity in Section 8.05 is not reproduced here.","prob_cat1":0.22,"prob_cat2":0.16}
]}
