{"clause_id":"c384","reasoning_cat1":"The access sentence is broken — 'shall provide access to information and documentation regarding the Mortgage Loans to the Trustee and, regarding the Mortgage Loans and their respective agents and accountants' — so it is impossible to tell who is entitled to access; 'The Master Servicer, the related Servicer' also omits a conjunction.","reasoning_cat2":"Section 4.01 contains a parallel but differently worded access provision covering Certificateholders and the FDIC, and the two do not line up on who may inspect or on what terms.","prob_cat1":0.36,"prob_cat2":0.28},
{"clause_id":"c385","reasoning_cat1":"'the Master Servicer, the related Servicer shall be entitled to setoff' omits a conjunction, and declaring the funds 'the sole and exclusive property of the Trustee' while allowing setoff is internally in tension.","reasoning_cat2":"The setoff right has to be squared with the Distribution Account withdrawal regime in Sections 5.02–5.03 and with Section 4.08(a)'s parallel retention rights.","prob_cat1":0.25,"prob_cat2":0.22},
{"clause_id":"c386","reasoning_cat1":"The obligation is enforcement of another agreement's obligation, and 'insurers meeting the eligibility requirements set forth in this Agreement' points to a standard the provision does not state.","reasoning_cat2":"No eligibility requirements for hazard insurers appear anywhere in this Agreement, so the cross-reference to 'this Agreement' has no content to supply.","prob_cat1":0.24,"prob_cat2":0.31},
{"clause_id":"c387","reasoning_cat1":"The mechanics are stated clearly enough once the section references are set aside.","reasoning_cat2":"It says deposits are made 'Pursuant to Sections 5.01 and 5.04' and are subject to withdrawal 'pursuant to Sections 5.02, 5.03 or 5.04', but Section 5.04 is the Yield Maintenance Credit Support Annex, not a deposit or withdrawal provision.","prob_cat1":0.15,"prob_cat2":0.38},
{"clause_id":"c388","reasoning_cat1":"'take such actions ... as shall be necessary to realize recovery' is an open standard, but the parenthetical enumerates what is meant.","reasoning_cat2":"Consistent with the Insurance Proceeds definition's carve-out for amounts applied to restoration and with Section 4.11(b).","prob_cat1":0.18,"prob_cat2":0.13},
{"clause_id":"c389","reasoning_cat1":"'best reasonable efforts' fuses two different standards of effort into one undefined hybrid, and the duty is layered with three separate 'to the extent required under' qualifiers.","reasoning_cat2":"The Primary Mortgage Insurance Policy definition is itself garbled at the end, so the object of this duty is imprecisely identified.","prob_cat1":0.31,"prob_cat2":0.21},
{"clause_id":"c390","reasoning_cat1":"'such reasonable action as shall be necessary to permit recovery' is a soft standard, but the deposit mechanics are clear.","reasoning_cat2":"It acts 'Pursuant to Sections 5.01 and 5.05', but Article V ends at Section 5.04 per the table of contents, so Section 5.05 does not exist.","prob_cat1":0.17,"prob_cat2":0.42},
{"clause_id":"c391","reasoning_cat1":"'Until all amounts distributable in respect of the Certificates have been distributed in full and the Master Servicer otherwise has fulfilled its obligations' uses 'and' where the two limbs do not naturally conjoin, leaving the custody period uncertain.","reasoning_cat2":"Section 4.07 permits release of the Mortgage File to the Servicer on payment in full and discharges the Custodian's responsibility, which cuts against the retention duty stated here.","prob_cat1":0.20,"prob_cat2":0.25},
{"clause_id":"c392","reasoning_cat1":"'as come into and continue in default and as to which no satisfactory arrangements can be made for collection' is an unmeasured standard governing when foreclosure must be pursued.","reasoning_cat2":"It is subordinated to the Servicing Agreements by the closing words, so its operative content is deferred; nothing in the Agreement contradicts it.","prob_cat1":0.27,"prob_cat2":0.15},
{"clause_id":"c393","reasoning_cat1":"Plainly drafted, with an express reduction for Compensating Interest.","reasoning_cat2":"Entitling the Master Servicer to float income here duplicates the same entitlement already built into both the Master Servicing Fee and Master Servicing Compensation definitions, so the same income is granted three times over.","prob_cat1":0.13,"prob_cat2":0.34},
{"clause_id":"c394","reasoning_cat1":"'as expeditiously as possible' is an open standard, and the tax constraint is expressed by reference to Code concepts rather than a rule of action.","reasoning_cat2":"Consistent with the REO Property definition and Section 4.02's REMIC covenants; the REO Imputed Interest definition assumes REO is held in REMIC I, as this provision does.","prob_cat1":0.24,"prob_cat2":0.15},
{"clause_id":"c395","reasoning_cat1":"A single short obligation with no open terms.","reasoning_cat2":"Consistent with the Protected Account definition and Section 4.15(d).","prob_cat1":0.06,"prob_cat2":0.08},
{"clause_id":"c396","reasoning_cat1":"The proviso refers to 'any such unreimbursed Monthly Advances', but the preceding sentence speaks of 'Advances' and 'other unreimbursed advances' — the term shifts mid-provision.","reasoning_cat2":"'Monthly Advances' is nowhere defined in Article I (only 'Advance' and 'Servicing Advances' are), so the proviso's subject cannot be identified from the rest of the instrument.","prob_cat1":0.28,"prob_cat2":0.30},
{"clause_id":"c397","reasoning_cat1":"'the related Distribution Account' implies more than one such account where the Agreement establishes only one; otherwise the timing is specific.","reasoning_cat2":"The Distribution Account definition describes a single account, and the Determination Date and Remittance Date definitions supply the timing; a minor mismatch only.","prob_cat1":0.15,"prob_cat2":0.16},
{"clause_id":"c398","reasoning_cat1":"'in all material respects', 'to the best of such officer's knowledge' and 'the nature and status of the cure provisions thereof' are soft, and the Master Servicer and Securities Administrator are required to deliver the certificate to the Securities Administrator, i.e. in part to itself.","reasoning_cat2":"It deems a Section 4.16 failure 'an Event of Default' although Event of Default is defined as 'As defined in Section 9.01', and it declares that 'This paragraph shall supersede any other provision in this Agreement or any other agreement to the contrary', setting up a direct override of Article IX.","prob_cat1":0.31,"prob_cat2":0.44},
{"clause_id":"c399","reasoning_cat1":"Long but highly specified; the soft points are 'material instance of noncompliance' and the 'taken as a whole' basis for assessment.","reasoning_cat2":"Like Section 4.16 it makes non-compliance 'an Event of Default' and says the paragraph 'shall supersede any other provision in this Agreement', which conflicts with the Event of Default definition keyed to Section 9.01 and with the master-servicer termination machinery in Article IX.","prob_cat1":0.28,"prob_cat2":0.41},
{"clause_id":"c400","reasoning_cat1":"Exhaustively detailed deadlines and allocations of responsibility; the only softness is 'in accordance with industry standards' and the negligence/bad faith carve-out at the end.","reasoning_cat2":"Its deadlines interlock (5 days, 10th day, 12th day, 13th day) and the reliance on 'the representations in Section 2.04(vi)' matches the Depositor's Exchange Act representation; consistent.","prob_cat1":0.19,"prob_cat2":0.17},
{"clause_id":"c401","reasoning_cat1":"The signing and approval deadlines collide — the Master Servicer must sign by close of business on the 3rd Business Day after the Reportable Event, yet the Depositor's approval of changes is due at the same moment.","reasoning_cat2":"That timing is harder to reconcile with the four-Business-Day filing deadline in the opening sentence and with the amendment fallback in Section 4.18(a)(vi)(B).","prob_cat1":0.28,"prob_cat2":0.22},
{"clause_id":"c402","reasoning_cat1":"Extremely detailed; the softness lies in the Securities Administrator's discretion to 'omit from the Form 10-K any annual compliance statement, assessment of compliance or attestation report that is not required to be filed'.","reasoning_cat2":"It requires 'a Sarbanes-Oxley Certification as described in Section 4.18(a)(ii)(D) below', but the certification is in fact described in subsection (a)(iii)(D) of this very provision, so the internal cross-reference is wrong.","prob_cat1":0.21,"prob_cat2":0.35},
{"clause_id":"c403","reasoning_cat1":"The text is broken at the point where the collective term is coined — 'Additional Form 10- Disclosure or any Form _8- K_ Disclosure Information (collectively, the obligation to include such Additional Information ... is subject to' — so the defined term 'Additional Disclosure' is never actually defined, and the notify-and-provide sentence names the same four parties as both givers and recipients.","reasoning_cat2":"'Additional Disclosure' is defined in Article I as 'As defined in Section 4.18', so the broken definition here leaves that Article I term without content, and Section 4.18(a)(v) and 4.18(b) both operate on it.","prob_cat1":0.46,"prob_cat2":0.40},
{"clause_id":"c404","reasoning_cat1":"Detailed procedures with clear fallbacks; the closing 'as the Securities Administrator reasonably deems appropriate' is a modest discretion.","reasoning_cat2":"The final sentence bars reimbursement of Section 4.18 fees from the Trust Fund, while subsections (a)(i)–(iii) make the Depositor responsible for those fees; the two can be read together but sit awkwardly.","prob_cat1":0.17,"prob_cat2":0.22},
{"clause_id":"c405","reasoning_cat1":"The first sentence indemnifies 'the Depositor and the Master Servicer and each of its officers' — the singular 'its' has two possible antecedents, which the second sentence corrects to 'their respective officers'.","reasoning_cat2":"It cross-refers to Sections 4.16, 4.17 and 4.18 consistently, and the 'Securities Administrator Information' construct matches the Article I definition; the parallel indemnity in Section 8.05 is not reproduced here.","prob_cat1":0.22,"prob_cat2":0.16}
]}

{"judgments": [
{"clause_id":"c406","reasoning_cat1":"'the Securities Administrator and the Master Servicer and each of its officers' uses a singular possessive for two indemnitees, an antecedent slip corrected only in the following sentence.","reasoning_cat2":"It mirrors the Securities Administrator's indemnity in the preceding paragraph and uses the same 'Depositor Information' construct as the Article I definition; consistent.","prob_cat1":0.20,"prob_cat2":0.14},
{"clause_id":"c407","reasoning_cat1":"'each of its respective officers' is grammatically incoherent, and the second sentence indemnifies only the Depositor while the first indemnifies both the Depositor and the Securities Administrator.","reasoning_cat2":"That asymmetry does not match the parallel Securities Administrator and Depositor indemnities, both of which run to two indemnitees in each sentence.","prob_cat1":0.26,"prob_cat2":0.25},
{"clause_id":"c408","reasoning_cat1":"'in such proportion as is appropriate to reflect the relative fault and the relative benefit of the respective parties' supplies no method at all, and 'the defaulting party' is used without definition.","reasoning_cat2":"It is a fallback to the three indemnities in Section 4.18(b) and does not contradict them.","prob_cat1":0.31,"prob_cat2":0.14},
{"clause_id":"c409","reasoning_cat1":"A single survival sentence with nothing to construe.","reasoning_cat2":"Consistent with the indemnities it preserves and with Section 4.17's post-termination reporting duties.","prob_cat1":0.05,"prob_cat2":0.07},
{"clause_id":"c410","reasoning_cat1":"'shall, constitute an Event of Default' contains a stray comma, and the final sentence's carve-out for failures caused by another party's non-delivery sits directly against the automatic deeming language earlier in the same paragraph.","reasoning_cat2":"It refers to termination 'pursuant to this Section 4.18(d)' although this text is in Section 4.18(b) and Section 4.18(d) is the notice-delivery provision, and it is the third paragraph in Article IV to declare that it 'shall supersede any other provision in this Agreement', overriding the Section 9.01 Event of Default definition.","prob_cat1":0.34,"prob_cat2":0.44},
